title: Git 工具箱
description: 在 VS Code 中管理本地忽略、本地分支和线上分支。

title: gdfmt
description: Validated GDScript formatting powered by Rust

title: Live Graph Coder (Beta V1)
description: A realtime live-graph of your codebase to work and search with the natural language meaning; runs locally on your machine.

title: Insert Numbers Live
description: Insert numbers, letters, dates, lists, random codes or expressions at multiple cursors, with a live preview before anything is inserted.

title: StackVet
description: Universal project health and static diagnostics engine for VS Code

title: Change Spotlight
description: Highlights the UI changes on your branch and tracks which ones you have actually looked at in the browser.

title: CSV Semantic Diff
description: Compare two CSV or TSV files by meaning: rows are matched by key column, so sorting, column order, quoting and number spelling are not changes. Added, removed, changed and moved rows, renamed columns, cell-level old → new.

title: GraphQL Breaking Changes
description: Diff two versions of a GraphQL schema and see what changed for API clients, with breaking changes flagged. Compare with any Git branch or tag, another file, or an open diff; SDL, split schemas and introspection JSON.

title: Terraform Plan Viewer
description: Read a Terraform or OpenTofu plan in a minute: a summary, destructive changes first, before/after for each attribute, drift, outputs and checks. Opens plan JSON, binary .tfplan files and CI log output, colour codes and all.

title: Agent Profiles
description: Switch the provider, gateway, key and models that Claude Code and Codex CLI use, from a form and the status bar. Keys stay in secret storage; every change is previewed as a diff and backed up.

title: Local Workspace Settings
description: A git-ignored settings.local.json for VS Code: commit the team's workspace settings, keep your own paths, colours and toggles out of Git. Settings changed in the Settings editor go to your local file.

title: WSLC Container Console
description: Visualize and operate WSL containers (wslc): containers, images, networks, volumes and sessions, plus port-publishing probes and wslc run command reconstruction.

title: CSV Simple Editor
description: View and edit CSV and TSV files as a table in VS Code. Auto-detect delimiters, sort and filter data, edit cells, and add or delete rows and columns.
